name: kya-pehnu-monorepo
description: Kya Pehnu? — hyper-local fashion delivery for Nagpur. Express backend + one unified Expo app serving both the customer and vendor flows.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,app -c magenta,cyan --kill-others-on-fail "bun run dev:backend" "bun run dev:app"
scripts.install:all: bun install && bun install --cwd backend && bun install --cwd customer-app
